_comment: Classifies each camera into a display section by matching keywords against its (lowercased) OLX title. Rules are checked top to bottom; the first rule with a matching keyword wins. A keyword starting with `^` must match the START of the title (e.g. `^obiektyw` tags a standalone lens but NOT a camera listed `... z obiektywem ...`). Anything unmatched uses `fallback` (most listings here are SLRs, so that is the safe default). `order` controls the on-page section order; a type that appears here but has no cameras is skipped, and a type not listed is shown last. Edit freely — the `type` strings are the headings shown to visitors.
